summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting its interim financial results for H1 2026 via press release. Revenue more than doubled to EUR 408 million, EBITDA to EUR 208 million, and profit rose to EUR 88 million, excluding prior one-off termination fees. Fleet utilization was stable at 66%. The company maintained full-year guidance and noted its recent acquisition of Menck on 11 August 2026 may impact guidance. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special-situation event. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. What to watch: potential guidance update from the Menck acquisition.
